items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I think he had Joe Avery with him, it was good, you know.

ctx.x: He did out at the Happy Man in that program, that was a pretty good thing. How you play?
How you sound? Real jazz I guess. I think he had Joe Avery with him, it was good, you know.
And Eddie Dawson was with him, so he's no young, but Eddie Dawson.
